reserveReview.rationale: The October 9 rendered dashboard discloses $103,721,175 Gold Carry, $29,350,639 thBILL, $324,217 USDC and $20,000 USDT. Their sum is $133,416,031, consistent with the rounded $133.42M reserve headline. The displayed deployed subtotal of $133,071,813 differs by $1 from the sum of its rounded component amounts; percentages use the sum of all four displayed component amounts, without assigning the discrepancy to any holding. Full-reserve weights are 100 times each amount divided by $133,416,031, with no percentage rounding. The 77.94%/22.06% labels cover deployed positions only. The public historical API's October 9 row independently identifies thBILL, USDC and USDT but omits Gold Carry and reports only $29,694,855.74, so it is not a whole-book denominator or evidence of undercollateralization. The dashboard remains the composition authority. These are rounded issuer-reported values, not independent assurance; internal gold-lease, futures-margin and Treasury-collateral allocations remain undisclosed.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: At Ethereum block 26088438, the disclosed Cash Wallet 0xec417ccb6dd26868cca993a92f37217b1d4b3c2f is a 4-of-5 Safe v1.4.1 with no modules and zero guard, receiving mint collateral. Theo's gold-carry explanation names Standard Chartered, Libeara, FundBridge and Wellington and claims CFTC-segregated futures margin at an unnamed US-regulated Fortune-500 FCM, but no account-level attestation, custody agreement or provider allocation is linked. These offchain provider roles and safeguards remain issuer claims; Libeara's tokenization role is not independent evidence of custody of every gold leg. MG999 bankruptcy remoteness and first-loss protection are issuer claims confined to that fund, not independently verified safeguards for the complete gold-carry slice or other reserve legs. The amount, availability and allocation of first-loss protection are not independently verified. Aggregate bankruptcy remoteness, segregation, rehypothecation terms and provider shares remain unknown.
